geometries.method: Editorial Gulf of St. Lawrence point off the Gaspé Peninsula, the source-described coastal jet region; not a measured core or length endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The source places the jet along the Gaspé Peninsula and reports a typical width of about 10–20 km near its strongest reach; width is not along-current length, and no comparable whole-current estimate is admitted.
